theme_rankings.risk: 토큰 인플레이션 압력 + 사용자 보상 의존. 베어 마켓에서 매도 압력 큼.

theme_rankings.why_now: 실제 매출 + 토큰 보유자 환원. P/S 가시화로 밸류에이션 재평가 단계.
theme_rankings.risk: 스마트컨트랙트 위험 + 규제. 매출은 시장 변동성에 큰 폭으로 변동.

theme_rankings.why_now: SOL·LTC ETF 가능성 + L2 거래량 회복. 다음 cycle 메이저 후보.
theme_rankings.risk: ETF 미승인 시 단기 조정. L2는 fee market 경쟁 심화.

theme_rankings.risk: 거시 유동성·금리에 직접 노출. ETF 자금 흐름이 단기 방향성을 좌우.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🌐 검증된 L1 — 이더 외 실수요 입증된 체인들

theme_rankings.risk: L1 간 경쟁 격화. 사용자·개발자 이탈 시 멀티플 빠르게 축소.

theme_rankings.why_now: 거버넌스보단 실제 트래픽·결제 사용처. TON·BNB 일일 활성 유저 검증.
theme_rankings.risk: 투기 대비 변동성 낮지만 폭발력도 작음. 환희장에서 underperform.

top_news.title: Asian Stocks to Edge Higher as Traders Await Fed: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: Asian stocks were poised for a modest gain as surging oil prices and rising bond yields kept investors cautious ahead of the Federal Reserve’s interest-rate decision.

top_news.title: Thai Finance Chief Sticks to 2.5% Growth Goal
top_news.summary: Thai Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas is sticking with the government’s forecast for 2.5% economic growth this year despite the surge in oil prices. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Fed Seen Hiking Rates in Defiance of Trump: Decision-Day Guide
top_news.summary: The Federal Reserve is expected to lift interest rates on Wednesday for the first time since 2023 as policymakers lose confidence that inflation will cool sufficiently without at least a nudge from the central bank.

top_news.title: Oaktree Sees Credit Investors ‘Finally Being Paid to Take Risk’
top_news.summary: Credit investors are “being paid to take risk, finally,” according to Oaktree Capital Management’s Danielle Poli.

top_news.title: Retirement Math Difficult for Investors, says BlackRock's Magyera
top_news.summary: Jaime Magyera, BlackRock senior managing director and head of US Wealth and head of Retirement, said advisers are using artificial intelligence to help parse increasingly complex capital markets after AI company Anthropic announces new ties with Blackrock. Magyera also said that AI is helping create more strategic customization for clients. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Market Attractive But Issues Lurk, Oaktree's Poli Says
top_news.summary: Oaktree Portfolio Manager Danielle Poli says markets may continue to see upward pressure on yields because investors do not yet believe inflation will be fully tamed. She speaks with Romaine Bostick on "Bloomberg The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Dutch Bros CEO Christine Barone on Expansion & Inflation
top_news.summary: Christine Barone, President & CEO of Dutch Bros, discussed the company’s aggressive growth strategy, saying the chain aims to reach 2,029 shops by 2029 and expects to add at least 185 locations this year. She said that pace is supported by a strong internal talent pipeline, with more than 500 operators ready to move into new states and markets as the company expands. She speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Venezuela Oil Opening Is ‘Smoke and Mirrors,’ Pickering Says
top_news.summary: Recent high-profile deals allowing foreign drillers to tap Venezuela’s vast oil reserves have failed to quell lingering concerns about contract sanctity in a nation with a history of nationalization, said energy investment banker Dan Pickering.

top_news.title: Bond Market’s ‘Extreme’ Short Counts on Fed to Deliver Rate Hike
top_news.summary: Bond traders have piled into bearish positions ahead of Wednesday’s Federal Reserve meeting, betting that the Treasury selloff driving yields to their highest levels in almost two decades will continue.

top_news.title: Will Be 'Extremely Difficult' For The FOMC To Not Raise Rates Says Richards
top_news.summary: Bond traders are pricing in a Federal Reserve interest-rate hike Wednesday with a level of conviction that has proven right for decades. Interest-rate swaps tied to Fed meeting dates show traders see more than a 90% chance that Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh and his colleagues will lift the benchmark policy rate by a quarter point from the current 3.5%-3.75% range.
